name: @scene/desktop
description: 场景通 桌面版（Electron 壳 + 内嵌本地服务端）

scripts.pack:mac: node scripts/prepare-server.mjs && node scripts/build.mjs && node scripts/clean-release.mjs mac-arm64 mac && electron-builder --mac
scripts.pack:win: node scripts/prepare-server.mjs --arch=x64 && node scripts/build.mjs && node scripts/clean-release.mjs win-unpacked && electron-builder --win --x64
scripts.pack:dir: node scripts/build.mjs && node scripts/clean-release.mjs mac-arm64 mac win-unpacked && electron-builder --dir
scripts.pack:mac:arm64: node scripts/prepare-server.mjs --arch=arm64 && node scripts/build.mjs && node scripts/clean-release.mjs mac-arm64 && electron-builder --mac --arm64
scripts.pack:mac:x64: node scripts/prepare-server.mjs --arch=x64 && node scripts/build.mjs && node scripts/clean-release.mjs mac && electron-builder --mac --x64
scripts.pack:win:x64: node scripts/prepare-server.mjs --arch=x64 && node scripts/build.mjs && node scripts/clean-release.mjs win-unpacked && electron-builder --win --x64
